items.title: Routine Expansion and Market Launch Scale discovery
items.name: Routine Expansion and Market Launch Scale discovery
items.summary: Planned discovery to understand which routine expansion and launch governance patterns should scale beyond Q2 pilots.
items.opportunity: Clarify which refill, cross-category routine, and launch readiness patterns work across markets without creating complexity for stores.

linkedInitiatives.description: Planned investment to scale routine basket expansion, cross-category recommendations, launch governance, and store readiness into more markets.

riskFocus.question: Which routine expansion and launch readiness improvements generalize across markets?
riskFocus.hypothesis: Routine expansion improves when refill education and advisor launch readiness are localized but measured through common KPIs.

plannedActivities: Identify localization needs for refill and launch education.
Define Q3 experiment cohorts and guardrail metrics.
items.decisionToMake: Decide which markets and categories receive Q3 routine expansion and launch governance rollout.
